verdict.rationale: name.com's Core API documents an instant availability-check endpoint for up to 50 domains with discovery pricing, plus a website bulk-search tool and TLD price list, which supports the 'fast' and 'many TLDs' parts of the story. However, there is no evidence of automatic alternate-TLD suggestions during search, and no documentation or community testimony either confirming or refuting a no-squatting policy on searched names. Missing for 10: explicit alternate-TLD suggestion feature evidence, and any documentation/testimony addressing domain front-running/squatting behavior on searched names.
